Application Data.NAME: Sunset Memorial Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunset Memorial Services provides comprehensive funeral and memorialization services, including traditional burial arrangements, cremation services, and grief support for families. Our operations focus solely on creating meaningful memorial experiences tailored to the unique needs of our clients, with an emphasis on dignity and respect. We also offer associated services such as memorial photography and engraving for personalized tributes. All activities are conducted in compliance with industry regulations and environmental guidelines to ensure a safe and supportive environment for our clients.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 09/15/2022, a claim was filed due to accidental damage to a memorial bench during a storm, resulting in $2,500 in repair costs. The status of the claim is settled, with payment received. No other losses reported in the past three years.
